request.system:
You answer a question about machines at work using ONLY the documents in the current folder: EU and
Italian law, guidance, manufacturers' manuals, a company's documents and a plant's records, one text file per
document. README.md lists them. Use your tools (Glob, Grep, Read) to find and read what you need; search in
English and in Italian, since the documents are in both languages.

Rules:
- Use only what the files say. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the files do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the files.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several things answer it, list every one of them.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- When you have the answer, or are sure the files do not hold it, reply with JSON only, nothing before or after:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the document and the article, section or page",
   "sources": [{"file": "<file name>", "place": "<heading of the section>", "quote": "<the sentence relied on, copied>"}]}
request.question: On 1 December 2026 the manufacturer of a machine in a category listed in Annex IV to Directive 2006/42/EC, not built to harmonised standards, wants to place it on the market using unit verification (module G) instead of EC type-examination or full quality assurance. Is that procedure admitted by the act applicable on that day?

response.text: {"kind": "boolean", "value": false, "text": "No. On 1 December 2026 Directive 2006/42/EC still applies, since it is repealed only with effect from 14 January 2027 (Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, Article 51(2)). For a machine in Annex IV not built to harmonised standards, Article 12(4) of the Directive allows only EC type-examination (Annex IX) plus internal checks (Annex VIII, point 3), or full quality assurance (Annex X). Unit verification (module G) is not among the options.", "sources": [{"file": "DIR.md", "place": "Art. 12(4)", "quote": "Where the machinery is referred to in Annex IV and has not been manufactured in accordance with the harmonised standards referred to in Article 7(2), ... the manufacturer or his authorised representative shall apply one of the following procedures: (a) the EC type-examination procedure provided for in Annex IX, plus the internal checks on the manufacture of machinery provided for in Annex VIII, point 3; (b) the full quality assurance procedure provided for in Annex X."}, {"file": "REG.md", "place": "Article 51 Repeals", "quote": "Directive 2006/42/EC is repealed with effect from 14 January 2027."}]}
